contents.text: What was Oracle's net income as a percentage of its total revenues in fiscal 2026, to one decimal place?

Oracle's net income as a percentage of its total revenues in fiscal 2026 was 25.8%. 

$17,087 million (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules) divided by $67,357 million (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules).
